title: Leveraging Machine Learning-Guided Molecular Simulations Coupled with Experimental Data to Decipher Membrane Binding Mechanisms of Aminosterols
authors: Stefano Muscat; Silvia Errico; Andrea Danani; Fabrizio Chiti; Gianvito Grasso
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习引导的分子模拟研究氨基甾醇与细胞膜的结合机制，对象为小分子-膜体系，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Understanding the molecular mechanisms of the interactions between specific compounds and cellular membranes is essential for numerous biotechnological applications, including targeted drug delivery, elucidation of drug mechanism of action, pathogen identification, and novel antibiotic development. However, the estimation of the free energy landscape associated with solute binding to realistic biological systems is still a challenging task. In this work, we leverage the Time-lagged Independent Component Analysis (TICA) in combination with neural networks (NN) through the Deep-TICA approach for determining the free energy associated with the membrane insertion processes of two natural aminosterol compounds, trodusquemine (TRO) and squalamine (SQ). These compounds are particularly noteworthy because they interact with the outer layer of neuron membranes protecting them from the toxic action of misfolded proteins involved in neurodegenerative disorders, both in their monomeric and oligomeric forms. We demonstrate how this strategy could be used to generate an effective collective variable for describing solute absorption in the membrane and for estimating free energy landscape of translocation via On-the-fly probability enhanced sampling (OPES) method. In this context, the computational protocol allowed an exhaustive characterization of the aminosterols entry pathway into a neuron-like lipid bilayer. Furthermore, it provided accurate prediction of membrane binding affinities, in close agreement with the experimental binding data obtained by using fluorescently-labelled aminosterols and large unilamellar vesicles (LUVs). The findings contribute significantly to our comprehension of aminosterol entry pathways and aminosterol-lipid membrane interactions. Finally, the deployed computational methods in this study further demonstrate considerable potential for investigating membrane binding processes.
abstract_zh: 理解特定化合物与细胞膜之间相互作用的分子机制，对于众多生物技术应用至关重要，包括靶向药物递送、药物作用机制阐明、病原体识别以及新型抗生素开发。然而，估算溶质与真实生物系统结合相关的自由能景观仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。在本工作中，我们利用时间滞后独立成分分析（TICA）结合神经网络（NN），通过Deep-TICA方法确定两种天然氨基甾醇化合物——曲杜司明（TRO）和角鲨胺（SQ）——膜插入过程的自由能。这些化合物尤为值得关注，因为它们与神经元膜外层相互作用，保护其免受错误折叠蛋白（无论是单体还是寡聚体形式）在神经退行性疾病中的毒性作用。我们展示了该策略如何用于生成有效的集体变量，以描述溶质在膜中的吸收，并通过实时概率增强采样（OPES）方法估算易位自由能景观。在此背景下，该计算协议实现了对氨基甾醇进入神经元样脂质双层途径的详尽表征。此外，它提供了膜结合亲和力的准确预测，与使用荧光标记氨基甾醇和大单层囊泡（LUVs）获得的实验结合数据高度一致。这些发现显著增进了我们对氨基甾醇进入途径及氨基甾醇-脂质膜相互作用的理解。最后，本研究所采用的计算方法进一步展示了在探究膜结合过程中的巨大潜力。
